## About
New Finish Automotive Interior Repair is a specialty car reconditioning and interior repair shop on Fish Stallings Road in Youngsville. Charles Doyle runs it as owner and operator, and he got his start doing paintless dent removal and interior work for Carmax.
We approach interior repair a little differently. To us it is as much an art form as a trade, and we really love cars. Whether it is a new Mercedes Benz or an older classic that needs a complete interior recoloring, we get it right.
Every vehicle is thoroughly inspected before it goes back to its owner. Our customers have rated us 5 stars across 70 Google reviews.

## Services
- Leather, vinyl, carpet and plastic repair: We repair leather, vinyl, carpet and plastic.
- Headliner replacement: One reviewer said the workmanship on their headliner replacement was excellent.
- Car detailing, stain removal and deodorizing: Detailing along with stain removal and deodorizing to freshen up the inside of your car.
- Headlight and paint restoration: Restoring cloudy headlights and tired paint.
- Paintless dent removal and paint corrections: Dent repair without repainting, plus paint corrections.

## FAQ
Q: Do I need an appointment?
A: You can set up an estimate appointment, or you can just drive on over to the shop.

Q: Do you work on classic cars?
A: Yes. We work on older classic cars as well as modern cars.
